events.comment: Shared combat rules. Runs before the Samurai events so they can react on the same frame.
Scene start: play this scene's own music, Thorns Beneath the Canopy.
Scene start: hide the red Invisible_Wall colliders. The Samurai sheet does this in his scenes, but this scene does not include it.

Arena test: ArenaChoice is a global number that picks the backdrop (0 original, 1 Deep Forest, 2 Moonlit Ruins, 3 Magic Cliffs, 4 Gothic Graveyard). At scene start, delete the original background unless it is picked.
Arena test: at scene start, delete the Deep Forest objects unless ArenaChoice is 1.
Arena test: at scene start, delete the Moonlit Ruins objects unless ArenaChoice is 2.
Arena test: at scene start, delete the Magic Cliffs objects unless ArenaChoice is 3.
Arena test: at scene start, delete the Gothic Graveyard objects unless ArenaChoice is 4.
Arena test: F4 switches to the next arena and restarts the fight. Debug key: remove before release.
Arena test: ambience for the picked arena (moving clouds, fog, light and fireflies), plus a 3 second label naming it.

inlineCode: // Arena test ambience: drifting clouds and fog, bobbing rocks, pulsing light, a flickering lamp and fireflies,
// for the arena picked by the global ArenaChoice. Generated from the arena preview; edit there and rebuild if possible.
// Arena ambience: one function shared by the browser preview and the GDevelop JS event.
// scene: { getObjects(name) -> objects with getX/setX/getY/setY/setOpacity, dt (seconds), pixiLayer }
// arena: one entry from arenas.js (only items[].name/at/alpha/anim and ambient are used).
// Starting opacity for see-through props (fog, clouds), set once.
for (const item of arena.items) if (item.alpha !== undefined)
if (!state.base[key]) state.base[key] = { x: o.getX(), y: o.getY(), phase: i * 1.7 + item.name.length };
// Wrap around the screen. Wide images (clouds) wrap at their own span.
o.setY(b.y + Math.round(Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI / a.period + b.phase) * a.amp));
const k = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI / a.period + b.phase);
// Fireflies: soft dots that wander and blink, drawn on the background layer.
state.container.zIndex = ff.z || 900; // Above the backdrop, below the floor strip (z 1000) and fighters.
state.flies.push({ s: s, x: ar[0] + Math.random() * (ar[2] - ar[0]), y: ar[1] + Math.random() * (ar[3] - ar[1]),
vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20, vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12, p: Math.random() * 10, rate: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.9 });
f.vx = Math.max(-22, Math.min(22, f.vx)); f.vy = Math.max(-14, Math.min(14, f.vy));
f.x += f.vx * dt; f.y += f.vy * dt;
f.x = Math.max(ar[0], Math.min(ar[2], f.x)); f.y = Math.max(ar[1], Math.min(ar[3], f.y));
// Label: which arena this is, for 3 seconds after the scene starts.
st.label = new PIXI.Text("Arena " + choice + ": " + (names[choice] || "?") + "   (F4 for the next one)", { fontFamily: "Arial", fontSize: 18, fill: 0xffffff, stroke: 0x000000, strokeThickness: 4 });
